---
title: Project agent scaffolding (init)
description: Scaffold AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, GEMINI.md, .gitignore entries, and optional .mcp.json for a repository.
---

`devex agent init` inspects top-level marker files in a repository offline and
scaffolds canonical project instructions alongside thin agent-specific shims.
It never downloads plugins or contacts external services.

```sh
devex agent init
devex agent init --dry-run
devex agent init --project-dir ./my-service --mcp
devex agent init --overwrite
```

## Generated files

| File | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `AGENTS.md` | Canonical project instructions with detected languages, task runner, test/lint commands, and editable team sections. Read natively by Codex, OpenCode, and Cursor. |
| `CLAUDE.md` | Thin shim importing `@AGENTS.md` for Claude Code without duplicating instructions. |
| `GEMINI.md` | Thin shim importing `@./AGENTS.md` for Gemini CLI without duplicating instructions. |
| `.gitignore` | Appends missing agent-local ignore entries (`.claude/settings.local.json` and `CLAUDE.local.md`) under `# DevEx agent-local files`, preserving every existing byte. |
| `.mcp.json` | Optional (`--mcp`): Claude Code project-scope MCP servers rendered from `agents.yaml`. |

## Offline stack detection

`devex agent init` reads only top-level repository files:

- **Languages:** `go.mod` (Go), `package.json` (JavaScript, or TypeScript when `tsconfig.json` is present), `Cargo.toml` (Rust), `pyproject.toml` / `requirements.txt` / `setup.py` (Python), `Gemfile` (Ruby).
- **Task runners:** `Taskfile.yml` / `Taskfile.yaml` (`task`), `mise.toml` / `.mise.toml` with `[tasks]` (`mise`), `justfile` (`just`), `Makefile` (`make`), and `package.json` `scripts` using the lockfile package manager (`pnpm-lock.yaml`, `yarn.lock`, `bun.lockb`, or `npm`).
- **Test and lint commands:** prefers `test` and `lint` targets defined by the detected task runner, falling back to language defaults only when marker files support them. Commands that cannot be detected are omitted.

## Existing files, backups, and preview

Preview every planned change without writing files, backups, or `.gitignore`
edits:

```sh
devex agent init --dry-run
```

You can also enable dry-run mode via the `DEVEX_DRY_RUN=1` environment
variable.

- Identical existing files are reported as `Unchanged`.
- Differing existing files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `GEMINI.md`, `.mcp.json`) are left untouched and reported as `Skipped (exists)` unless `--overwrite` is passed.
- With `--overwrite`, differing files are backed up beside the original as `<name>.devex-backup-<unixnano>` before replacement, and both paths are printed.
- `.gitignore` only appends missing entries and never requires `--overwrite`.
- All target paths are validated inside `--project-dir` before anything is written; symlinks and non-regular files are rejected with zero writes.

## Project-scope MCP servers (`--mcp`)

Pass `--mcp` to render `.mcp.json` from `agents.mcp_servers` entries in
`agents.yaml` whose `agents` list is empty or includes `claude`, plus the
`devex` server when `agents.devex_mcp` is `true`:

```sh
devex agent init --mcp
```

`agents.yaml` is validated first so literal secrets are rejected before any
files are written. Environment references (`${env:VAR}` and
`Bearer ${env:VAR}`) are rendered in Claude Code's `.mcp.json` expansion syntax
(`${VAR}` and `Bearer ${VAR}`). If no Claude-compatible servers are configured,
`.mcp.json` is skipped.

## Flags

| Flag | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `--project-dir DIR` | Target project directory (must already exist; defaults to current working directory) |
| `--overwrite` | Replace differing existing files and keep timestamped backups |
| `--mcp` | Render Claude Code project-scope `.mcp.json` from `agents.yaml` |
| `--dry-run` (global) | Preview planned changes without writing files (also honors `DEVEX_DRY_RUN`) |
